data.one_liner: Generate random names and surnames based on common names in various global zones.
data.what_it_does: Provides a RandomNames class to generate random first names, last names, or full names for men and women. Supports multiple geographic zones and allows passing a custom Random instance.
use_when: You need mock or placeholder person names for UI development.
You are building a game or app requiring procedurally generated characters.
avoid_when: You need real user data or complex demographic databases beyond common name lists.
strengths: Supports a large number of zones and countries.
Easy to use with straightforward class and method design.
weaknesses: Limited to a list of the 100 most common names and surnames per zone.
data.minimal_example:
var randomNames = RandomNames(Zone.us);
String fullName = randomNames.fullName();
